blurb: Guests experience San Diego's iconic highlights including Coronado, Gaslamp Quarter, Balboa Park, and La Jolla through guided tours by local experts. Tours include sightseeing, e-bike adventures, and Segway rides with a focus on history, culture, and oceanfront scenery. Options range from a few hours to full-day experiences, some including ferry rides and train travel to Los Angeles.

quotes.author: Braun Mincher
quotes.text: Our family had a GREAT 2-hour Segway tour of La Jolla yesterday with Jeff as our guide. We got to ride on both the streets and sidewalks (treated just like a pedestrian), and got to see some amazing ocean views, real estate and even the famous sea lions! Kenneth, the owner, was most accommodating in booking our 8-year-old twin boys with us (who did GREAT by the way – they even had smaller Segways for one of them). Everything was perfect and we would highly recommend this tour for anyone who wants to explore the La Jolla area by Segway! Thanks for the awesome experience!

quotes.author: Michael Szeto
quotes.text: We spent 4 hours with Julia on the San Diego Tour. Julia was very informative, fun and great tour guide. Thanks Julia for all the beautiful memories we have gained from this great tour. We highly recommend Julia as a tour guide on your next tour with Another Side of San Diego Tours!!

quotes.author: Stephanie Durant
quotes.text: This is the best way to see La Jolla, especially if you don't have much time available. It is absolutely beautiful there and you will love all of the sights you see - the aqua blue waters, sea lions, caves, beautiful flowers and trees, gorgeous houses, and more!

quotes.author: Oliva Baronner
quotes.text: Great new experience for my husband and me on his birthday! Amy was awesome. She was pleasant, informative, observant, and made us feel safe and comfortable on the Segway from beginning to end. Loved having her as our tour guide!
